Shurdington CofE Primary
Be the BEST we can be, through love.
Believe Enjoy Succeed Together
'Love God and love your neighbour as you love yourself.'
Taken from Matthew 22, verses 37 and 39.
HOME SCHOOL AGREEMENT
Hello and thank you for visiting our school website. I am incredibly proud to be the Headteacher at Shurdington Church of England Primary School and I hope that, as you look through our website, you will understand why.
Jon Millin Headteacher
If you would like a paper copy of any of the information (not photos unfortunately) on our school’s website, we will provide this free of charge. Please contact the school office for more information.
Follow us on Twitter: @ShurdyPrimary
Not part of our Shurdington family yet? Are you looking for a kind and caring Primary School for your child? Why not arrange to visit our school to look around at a time that suits you? Give us a call to arrange a visit.
